summary.text: Travis Nelson is a Democratic state representative from Oregon House District 44 who was appointed to the seat on February 1, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Ballotpedia lists him with Democratic and Working Families Party nominations.

paragraphs.text: Travis Nelson was appointed to the Oregon House to replace Tina Kotek.
In the 2023-2024 legislative term, Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the Behavioral Health Committee and a member of the Business and Labor and Early Childhood committees.
